title: Prompt cache misses after changing tool_choice, images, effort, or thinking settings between calls
symptoms: cache_read_input_tokens drops to 0 on a turn where only tool_choice changed
The cache is rewritten after toggling output_config.effort or the thinking mode
Adding one image anywhere in the prompt re-creates the message cache
cause: The cache follows the order tools, then system, then messages, and these settings are rendered into the prompt. Changing tool_choice, adding or removing any image, or changing thinking or effort invalidates the message level, and on some models the tool and system levels too; editing tool definitions invalidates everything.
fix: Keep tools, tool_choice, thinking, and effort fixed for a conversation. To add an instruction mid-conversation on models that support it, append a role system message to messages instead of editing the top-level system field.
apply: messages.push({ role: "system", content: "From now on, answer in French." }); // keeps the cached prefix on supported models
affected: Claude Messages API prompt caching, as of 2026-10; mid-conversation system messages on Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Opus 5, Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, not Sonnet 5
